input.summary: Insert Licensor IP indemnity with customary exclusions, remedies and 3x annual fees super-cap, and conform Article XIII so it does not negate the indemnity.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains only a Licensee indemnity running to Licensor, and Article XIII expressly bars any Licensor liability for infringement claims, so we add a Licensor IP indemnity with the usual modification, combination and specification exclusions and procure/modify/replace/refund remedies, subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees. We carve that indemnity out of Article XIII(a) and (b) only as needed to make it effective; this is our fallback position.

ops.text: ARTICLE XII-A LICENSOR IP INDEMNITY Licensor shall indemnify Licensee against any third-party claim alleging that the Licensed Technology infringes or misappropriates any intellectual property right, excluding any claim arising from (i) modifications to the Licensed Technology made by Licensee, (ii) combination of the Licensed Technology with items not supplied by Licensor, or (iii) Licensee's specifications. Licensor shall procure for Licensee the right to continue using, or shall modify or replace, the affected Licensed Technology, and if none of those remedies is available, Licensor shall refund the fees paid by Licensee for the affected Licensed Technology. Licensor's aggregate liability under this Article XII-A shall not exceed three times the annual fees paid by Licensee under this Agreement.

ops.oldText: OR OTHERWISE UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE BY LICENSEE OR ANY THIRD PARTY THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED, RESULTS OR MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT, DEPRIVATION OR VIOLATION OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CONSTITUTIONAL, STATUTORY, CONTRACTUAL, COMMON LAW OR OTHER RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON (b) IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY
ops.newText: OR OTHERWISE EXCEPT FOR LICENSOR'S INDEMNITY OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE XII-A, UNDER NO CIRCUMSTANCE SHALL LICENSOR BE LIABLE FOR ANY ACTIONS, CLAIMS OR THE LIKE BY LICENSEE OR ANY THIRD PARTY THAT THE USE OF THE LICENSED TECHNOLOGY HAS RESULTED, RESULTS OR MAY RESULT IN ANY INFRINGEMENT, DEPRIVATION OR VIOLATION OF THE INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, CONSTITUTIONAL, STATUTORY, CONTRACTUAL, COMMON LAW OR OTHER RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON (b) EXCEPT FOR LICENSOR'S INDEMNITY OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE XII-A, IN NO EVENT SHALL LICENSOR'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY
